.
Aastha TV aapka apna spiritual aur devotional channel hai, jahan bhakti, katha, pravachan aur dharmik gyaan ke madhyam se jeevan ko ek nayi disha milti hai. Yahan shraddha, shanti aur adhyatmikta ka anubhav hota hai, jo mann ko sthir aur jeevan ko samriddh banata hai.
.
Is channel par desh ke prasiddh sant aur kathavachak apne anubhav aur vicharon se margdarshan dete hain, jaise Pandit Pradeep Mishra ji ki Shiv Mahapuran Katha, Morari Bapu ji ki Ram Katha, Devkinandan Thakur ji aur Rameshbhai Oza ji ki Shrimad Bhagwat Katha, Chinmayanand Bapu ji ke pravachan, Govind Dev Giri ji ki Ram Katha aur Chatur Narayan Parashar ji ki kathayein.
.
